lines.en: I walk slowly toward you.
I do not watch the road; only you.
My body is very thin.
I hang half an inch above the ground.
I walk toward that little light.
Ash scatters under my steps.
I stop at every step.
I do not know where I am.
I drift in from the bone wastes.

lines.zh: 我这身子没有一点重量
lines.en: This body of mine has no weight.
I head toward where the living are.
My shadow is grey.
I stop midair and stare at you.

lines.zh: 我脸上什么表情都没有
lines.en: My face holds no expression at all.
I wait for you to look back.
I have no need to breathe anymore.
All sounds have drawn away.
I lift a hand and let it fall.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是怎么死的
lines.en: I remember how I died.
But not my name.
The light here is weak.
I stare at that small brightness.
I neither move nor leave.
The wind passes straight through me.
I count your breaths.
Ash falls from me.
I have waited a long time.
You are warm.
I have not been near warmth in ages.

lines.zh: 我慢慢低下头，看向你的灯。
lines.en: I lower my head toward your lamp.
You have finally seen me.
I have stayed close beside you.
Are you dead too?
Your shadow is still clear.
Mine has faded.
I want to ask you something.
But I cannot remember what.
I will not harm you.
I only want someone to look.
Do not look away.

lines.zh: 那盏灯，我要走过去吹灭。
lines.en: That lamp — I'll walk over and put it out.
I have not been seen in a long time.
When you blink, I am still here.
I am right before you.
Your face is a little like mine.
Half my shape has scattered.
I gather myself together again.
I pulled back from that.

lines.zh: 灰从我身上落得更多了
lines.en: More ash falls from me.
I feel no pain at all.
I am only fainter.
I look at my own hand.
I am still here.

lines.zh: 你打到的只是一个影子
lines.en: You struck only a shadow.
I will slowly return.
That is not for me.
I no longer need to eat.
But I walk over anyway.
I remember what hunger felt like.
That little thing in your hand is bright.
I reach out, and do not touch.

lines.zh: 我看着它，像看一个从前
lines.en: I look at it as at a former life.
Keep this thing.
I cannot eat it.
Do not waste it on me.
You struck me like mist.
I will not step back.

lines.zh: 你身上有一点热传过来
lines.en: A little warmth passed from you.
This body of mine is hollow.
You passed halfway through.
I gathered myself again.
Do not push me.
I come apart at a touch.
Let me stand a moment.
Just stand here.
I have been dead a long time.
I cannot recall such things.
But I do not want to be alone.
Stand beside me.
I will not touch you.
Will I not grow cold?
We watch that little fire together.
That little fire is nearly out.

lines.zh: 灭了以后我可能就走了
lines.en: When it goes out, I may leave.
So do not move now.
I reach out, and my hand passes through.
I cannot hold things.
I try a second time.
But still I cannot hold it.
Looking at it is enough.
You hold it for me.
This is a little warm.
It looks better in your hand.
I have noted its shape.
Put it back.
I see that little light.
That little light is on you.
I close in foot by foot.
It is not out of hatred.
I only want to be near warmth.
I will put that light out.
That is not what I want.
But I cannot stop.
I did not want this.
Put it away.
I never take my eyes off that light.
It is in your hand.
I go toward it step by step.

lines.zh: 我走过去，把那盏灯按灭
lines.en: I'll walk over and put that lamp out

lines.zh: 这里的灰都往我这边聚
lines.en: The ash is gathering toward me.
You retreat; I still follow.
The light is growing smaller.
I am not blowing it out.
It is afraid of me.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没有靠近过火
lines.en: I have not been near fire in ages.
Let me look at it once.
Let me look at that fire.
I reach out, and the light dims.
I did not touch you.
I only came too close.
That little fire went out.
There is more ash on me.
You have stepped back.
I am cold again.
I suppose I should go.
All the fires here fear me.
I do not resent these fires.
The ash gathers into a shape.
I show myself out of the ash.
My body is thin and light.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己死了多久
lines.en: I do not know how long I have been dead.

lines.zh: 我记得最后是往下掉的
lines.en: I remember falling at the end.
This is not that place.
Bones and ash everywhere.
I lift my face.
There is a little light far off.
I go there step by step.
I have not seen the living in ages.
Do not move about.
I will go and have a look.
I reach a hand toward that light.
The fire comes near; I draw back.
I fell again.
Water presses me into a lump.
I am scattered all at once.

lines.zh: 那东西穿过我，留下一个洞
lines.en: It passes through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 那道光照得我几乎看不见
lines.en: That light leaves me nearly blind.
I stopped eating long ago.
Lightning lights all of me; it hurts.

lines.zh: 这里和我掉下去的地方很像
lines.en: This is much like where I fell.
